clusters.name: Your grandfather Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around the move across the country in March 1952: within months, your grandmother June grew homesick and anxious, writing daily to her sister; your grandfather worked long hours away from home and the two clashed over money for trees; your father Glen got into fights at his new school; your grandfather cut off his brother Harlan over their father's land money; and your grandmother kept to her bed for weeks that winter before joining the church choir and settling by autumn.

clusters.name: Your grandfather Walter's orchard failed, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard failing in May 1968: your grandfather drank heavily and clashed with your father over the loan; your father took over the family's money and the bank talks; your brother Carl's asthma worsened that winter; you began wetting the bed in spring; and by autumn your grandfather stopped drinking and took work pruning trees, his functioning recovered.

clusters.name: Your father Glen lost his job at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around your father losing his job in February 1975: he sat out in the truck most of that year; he and your mother fought loudly over money; your mother took a second job cleaning offices at night; you stopped eating and lost weight that summer; you withdrew to your room and kept your distance from your mother; your grandfather drank again after six years without it; and by summer you were eating again and made the track team.

clusters.name: Your partner's mother Wilma moved into your house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma moving into your home in January 1990: you clashed with her over the children's bedtimes and meals; your partner Hollis worked late and kept away from the rows; he took his mother's side; your son Owen had tantrums at preschool; Wilma took over your daughter Lily's care; you developed eczema on both hands; you and Hollis fought most nights; and by summer 1991 when Wilma moved to a flat in town, your eczema cleared.

periods.words: The one that stands out is the year Dad lost his job, when I was 14.
